in_sanskrit.name: अन्शुक
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit word anshu, meaning 'shadow' or 'dark'. Anshuk is a name that evokes a sense of mystery and depth.

in_hindi.name: अन्शुक
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, Anshuk can be translated to 'more' or 'additional'. It is a name that suggests growth, expansion, and abundance.

in_tamil.name: அன்ஷுக்
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, Anshuk can be translated to 'added' or 'additional'. It is a name that conveys the idea of something new or extra.

in_telugu.name: అన్శుక్
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, Anshuk can be translated to 'addition' or 'more'. It is a name that signifies growth, expansion, and abundance.

in_marathi.name: Anshuk
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Darkness destroys, illumines
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anshuk हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anshuk is a Sanskrit name derived from the word anshus meaning 'darkness'. It is believed that the name symbolizes the power of light to destroy darkness. In Hindu mythology, Anshuk is also considered the name of the sun god, Surya, who is believed to illuminate the world and bring life.
